message.content:
Based on the search results, **Barry Watson** played the oldest brother Matt Camden in *7th Heaven*. He portrayed the eldest son of Reverend Eric and Annie Camden from 1996 to 2002 (seasons 1-6), and later made guest appearances in subsequent seasons. Watson left the show in 2001 after being diagnosed with Hodgkin's Lymphoma, though he had actually decided to leave months before the diagnosis.
